canonical_policy: fixed directory inode; recreate source and fresh single-commit Git each stage; no prior patch as source
grader: separate network-none readonly fixed-tests container; trusted pytest loaded before candidate imports
memory_policy: unique physical namespace per repetition/arm; plain zero construction; static/CAMI separately charged identical origin generation and preparation; persistent memory across four canonical stages

modes.default: validate and plan only; zero containers/models
modes.resume: reuse terminal attempts; abandon partial attempts; no retries
modes.run-model: explicit authorization + exact study SHA + runtime manifest

normalization.development: fixture-manifest + task-prompts + task-evaluation + source-only origin seed
normalization.heldout: extracted portable tasks.json + private oracle inventory + origin seed; no gold source read

source_scope: regular src/**; addition/deletion/mode changes exported independent of Git
